snapshot.title: Drone Apprehended — Event Closed

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The drone has been located and the operator apprehended by Harwick Police. The counter-UAS team confirmed the device as a DJI Matrice 350 with no payload. The Group’s operations remain suspended pending a formal restart order. All incident data has been preserved. The IC has closed the event and initiated client notification through the General Manager.
finalState: The drone identified as 'RID-BM-12-004' has been confirmed as a non-hostile DJI Matrice 350 with no payload.
Harwick Police have apprehended the operator near the Creek Test Area woods.
All Group operations at Hangar 1 and Horton Field remain suspended.
The incident folder on HUOG-NAS01 is complete with all logs, photos, and notification records.
The IC has issued a formal closure and initiated client notification via the General Manager.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. The event is closed. Please put down your radios and devices. We will now begin the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things to fix
hotWashQuestions: What was the most effective action taken during the incident response?
How could the media messaging have been improved to reduce public confusion?
What lessons can be drawn from the timeline of law enforcement and regulatory involvement?
How did the team manage conflicting pressures from public perception, law enforcement, and internal protocol?
What improvements are needed in the process for preserving evidence and initiating the hot wash?
fields.facilitatorNote: Ensure the paper copy of the notification record is collected and placed in the ASO’s physical file. Confirm all digital logs are locked in the incident folder on HUOG-NAS01.
